questions.stem: When does the aortic valve open during the cardiac cycle?

options.text: When atrial pressure exceeds ventricular pressure
When ventricular pressure exceeds aortic pressure
During diastole when all chambers are relaxed
When the sinoatrial node fires an impulse

questions.explanation: The aortic valve opens during ventricular systole when the pressure in the left ventricle rises above the pressure in the aorta, allowing blood to be ejected into the aorta.
